name: Sarah Zatko
biography: Sarah Zatko is the Chief Scientist at the Cyber Independent Testing Lab (CITL), where she develops testing protocols to assess the security and risk profile of commercial software. She also works on developing automated reporting mechanisms to make such information understandable and accessible to a variety of software consumers. The CITL is a non-profit organization dedicated to empowering consumers to understand risk in software products. Sarah has degrees in Math and Computer Science from MIT and Boston University. Prior to her position at CITL, she worked as a computer security professional in the public and private sector. cyber-itl.org
